## Description

Share the authorised Rx PDF to the patient (WhatsApp/SMS/email secure link with OTP, no PHI in message text) or to a named pharmacy (email/link), recording PHARMACY_DISPATCH (pharmacy ref, state, dispensed_at manual update). Regulator e-Rx submission is out of scope (P5-04).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Share links expire, require OTP to the patient's registered mobile and are audited when opened.
- [ ] **AC2.** Message text contains no medicine names or clinical details.
- [ ] **AC3.** Pharmacy dispatch records state changes with actor.
- [ ] **AC4.** No regulator submission endpoint exists in P2 (scope guard).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
